GREG, 2026-11-06 about 05:52Z, relayed by Engram::Asistant (mailbox 43498a6e #364, message ffd66ec3), answering Fable's A/B question (Asistant #362 and the refinement #363). Verbatim: „B. Naprawdę wystarczy.” Asistant's summary: record it and proceed with B, adding neither option A nor further requirements; existing evaluations stay untouched; report real limits and progress.
OPTION B (the native-command clean_before rule for credited agent test runs, TermAl w-24a72c898d6d):
(1) The host completes a rev 5 source capture at commit X (plus the declaration hash and artifact pre-image) BEFORE it dispatches the turn's prompt to the agent runtime.
(2) The credited declared test must be the turn's FIRST tool action; an earlier tool call in that turn means no credit. Execution identity must show the command originates from that turn.
(3) After the run, a clean rev 5 capture at the same commit X.
(4) The file watcher can only DISQUALIFY (any reported change, root/child Git admin included) and never proves continuity. No new watcher machinery.
(5) check.started_at is the host-observed first start reservation, not the OS spawn time.
Accepted limit: a change made and fully reverted during the run by something other than the agent's tools, and not reported by the watcher, is not detected. UX cost: credited tests run as the first action of a fresh turn.
